objective: Seek out the Clerk Daltry in the Darkshire Town Hall.

description: Last night a horrible disturbance rippled through my veins.  I sensed that my granddaughter, Alyssa, was in great danger.  I consulted the cards and Death stared up at me from the table.
After taking a long journey through a dark trance I was able to uncover a clue to this terrifying mystery.  A name came to me, the name of Stalvan.
Seek out the Clerk in the Town Hall and see if you can find out more about this character.  I fear for us all.
completion: Ah so Madame Eva sent you....
